title: Wolf in the Potion Library
description: A black wolf with glowing purple eyes emerges from an open dark doorway into a narrow, endless library corridor lined with shelves of glowing potion bottles. Floating magical books with green glowing symbols hover in the air, surrounded by swirling purple and pink energy trails under a misty green light.
prompt: A black wolf with glowing purple eyes steps out from a dark doorway into an infinite narrow corridor lined with tall shelves packed with glowing potion bottles on both sides. Several ancient books float in the air with bright green magical symbols and runes glowing on their pages. Swirling trails of purple and pink energy flow through the scene, dramatic misty green light emanates from the center, dark fantasy atmosphere, painterly style
